mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_refund_approval_receipt(tenant_id,receipt_no,source_issuer,source_subject,event_id,refund_no,fact_hash,payload_hash,payload_cipher,key_version,created_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{number},#{issuer},#{subject},#{event},#{refund},#{facts},#{hash},#{cipher},#{key},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_refund_approval_receipt.id
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_no,refund_no,fact_hash,payload_hash,payload_cipher,key_version FROM tc_refund_approval_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_issuer=#{issuer} AND source_subject=#{subject} AND event_id=#{event} FOR UPDATE
